rules.collision: Unicode casefold within active category; active category names globally unique
rules.ordering: manual persisted order, type filter never rewrites hidden rows
rules.trash: metadata only; never erase recipe, LUT or reference assets

cases.scenario: Drag categories and presets; restart; exact order persists
Cross-category drag places before target preset or at category end; stable ID and module payload hashes unchanged
Right-click preset rename/delete; keyboard More controls provide same actions; Escape closes action group
Filter portrait/color/custom kinds; move visible items without dropping or renumbering hidden siblings
Create/rename/reorder/delete empty category and restore it; reject deleting populated or offline-referenced category
Trash then restart then restore preset; recipe/custom-LUT/reference file hashes and ID all unchanged
Reject built-in rename/trash/cross-category move; allow within-built-in ordering; system categories cannot be renamed or deleted
Whitespace, NFC composed/decomposed names, emoji, 20/21 code points, controls, casefold collisions, duplicate rename/move/restore; legacy names remain readable
Two processes edit same revision; one succeeds and one rejects; failed/stale operation never overwrites metadata
Save/import versus organisation transaction serialize under same catalogue lock; forced overwrite of trashed/aliased record rejected, no recipe lost
Disk-full/temp-write/fsync/replace/parent-fsync failures; uncertain commit only queried, not retried; persisted receipt shares metadata transaction
Receipt replay same ID+payload does not mutate; ID+different payload rejected; lost/evicted/restarted mailbox reports uncertainty; durable receipt query resolves committed operation
Corrupt/duplicate-field/oversized/symlink sidecar, malformed category refs, duplicate source IDs: reject without overwriting original
Missing recipe remains offline metadata reference; replacing same ID reconnects original category/order; duplicate active names require explicit resolution
Export/import/apply/batch keep IDs, recipes, custom LUT and reference asset IDs; trashed presets absent from effective catalogue; restore reconnects
